_comment: Report-row resolution for 'R:'/'R;' rows. Key = matrix 'System Components' label, normalized: leading 'R:'/'R;' stripped, lowercased, whitespace-collapsed. 'reports' maps a label -> AD_Process.ad_process_uu (the iDempiere Name column in the sheet is unreliable, so we resolve by label here). 'ignore' lists report rows deliberately NOT yet managed. Every 'R:' row in the sheet MUST appear in exactly one of 'reports' or 'ignore', otherwise the generator fails loudly. To onboard a report: move its label from 'ignore' to 'reports' with the process UU.
